account_key_path.description: Path to the account private key used to authenticate with the CA. Must be unique per account.

acme_directory.description: ACME directory URL for the certificate authority (e.g., Let's Encrypt production).

default_ca.description: Default CA identifier (e.g., 'letsencrypt', 'zerossl'). Used when omitting the --ca flag.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging to stderr.

dns_alias.description: Enable DNS alias mode for challenges (allows pointing DNS records to a proxy zone).

custom_ca_bundle.description: Optional path to a custom CA certificate bundle (PEM format) for verifying TLS connections.

http_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for HTTP requests to the ACME server.

retry_max.description: Maximum number of retries for failed HTTP requests.

retry_delay.description: Delay in seconds between retries of failed requests.

acme_home.description: Base directory for storing account, domain, and certificate data.

account_key_length.description: Default bit length for account keys (RSA only). Use 256 or 384 for ECDSA.

cert_key_length.description: Default key length for domain certificates (unless overridden per site).

use_eab.description: Enable External Account Binding (required by some CAs like GoDaddy for account migration).

eab_kid.description: External Account Binding Key Identifier (provided by CA).

eab_hmac_key.description: Base64-encoded HMAC key for EAB (provided by CA).

dns_plugins.description: List of DNS plugins to enable (must exist in acme_home/dnsapi/).

dns_credentials.description: API credentials for DNS providers (e.g., for manual or alias mode).

api_key.description: API key or token for the provider (e.g., CF_API_KEY=...)

ocsp.description: Enable OCSP stapling (requires OCSP-capable server setup).

acme_sh_path.description: Path to the main acme.sh script (if installed in a non-standard location).

auto_renew.description: Enable automatic renewal of certificates via cron/systemd.

auto_renew_days.description: Number of days before certificate expiry to trigger renewal.

account_email.description: Email address for account registration and expiry notifications.

no_reinstall.description: Skip reinstalling renewed certificates (useful in containerized setups).

strict_mode.description: Enable strict TLS validation (recommended for production).

log_file.description: Path to log file. Empty to disable file logging.

default_key_algo.description: Default key algorithm for new certificates ('rsa' or 'ecdsa').

country_code.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code for certificate subject (e.g., 'US').

state.description: State or province name for certificate subject.

location.description: City or locality for certificate subject.

organization_unit.description: Organizational unit (e.g., department) for certificate subject.

json_output.description: Output status and results in JSON format for external tools.
